title: Special Order for ESS Transportation, Inc., ex parte. — ESS Transportation, Inc., ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC Nos. 8149 & 8250. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC Nos. 8149 & 8250 hereby are, cancelled.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                           SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 63-2026

                              ESS TRANSPORTATION, INC.
                                      EX PARTE

                    In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC Nos. 8149 & 8250
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC Nos. 8149 & 8250 per a notarized
affidavit received on September 16, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC Nos. 8149 & 8250
held by ESS Transportation, Inc. are hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding
fees and fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.

                                (Decided September 16, 2026)




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
September 17, 2026
